title: Hydrate restored dashboard panes after Golden Layout layout load
observed_behavior: Loading a saved dashboard layout could reopen the correct tabs but leave restored panes such as `2D Network`, `Table`, `Aggregate`, `Crosstab`, and `Waterfall` blank or stale until a second manual interaction rebuilt them.
intended_behavior: A saved multi-pane dashboard should reopen into interactive panes immediately after the saved Golden Layout state is applied.
cause_summary: Dashboard restore and existing-tab focus paths were not consistently calling per-view load hooks on the actual component instances, so several panes never rehydrated after layout load or refocus.
fix_summary: `publishLoadNewData()` now drives `componentRef.instance.onLoadNewData()`, existing-tab dashboard focus rehydrates the affected views, and the Files pane no longer writes back into unmounted dashboard state during restore.
notes: Closed after both maintained dashboard view-state specs passed on April 10, 2026.

title: Refresh hidden Bubble panes during dashboard filtering changes
observed_behavior: With Bubble open in the dashboard but not currently focused, changing root filtering controls could update global stats and sibling panes while Bubble kept its pre-filter rendered membership until the view was forced through a deeper rebuild.
intended_behavior: Dashboard Bubble panes should resync from the current session graph when filtering changes occur outside Bubble, even if Bubble was hidden when the change happened.
cause_summary: Bubble only refreshed reliably from its own active interaction path, so hidden-tab dashboard filtering changes could leave the rendered Bubble node set stale.
fix_summary: Bubble now syncs from session state on `networkUpdated` while active and on pane show, and its rendered data nodes are filtered back to the current visible-node set before rerender.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard filtering journey passed end-to-end on April 10, 2026.

title: Rebuild hidden Table panes during dashboard restore and filtering changes
observed_behavior: In dashboard mode, Table could reopen blank after saved-layout restore or keep stale rows after external filtering while the Table tab was hidden.
intended_behavior: Dashboard Table panes should rebuild their current dataset automatically after saved-layout hydration, pane show, and external filtering changes.
cause_summary: Table relied too heavily on active-tab entry paths and did not consistently rebuild its dataset on dashboard restore, pane show, or shared network-update events.
fix_summary: Table now rebuilds through `onLoadNewData()`, pane show, `networkUpdated$`, and `onFilterDataChange()` so hidden dashboard Table panes reopen with current rows instead of stale or empty state.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard layout and dashboard filtering specs both passed on April 10, 2026.

title: Derive dashboard non-timeline data views from the current filtered graph
observed_behavior: During dashboard filtering coverage, the shared non-timeline data-view helpers could preserve hidden singleton or small-cluster nodes and stale cluster ids, which left Waterfall and cluster-backed Aggregate expectations out of sync with the current non-timeline filtered graph.
intended_behavior: Dashboard non-target data views should derive node and cluster datasets from the current non-timeline visible graph plus the active Minimum Cluster Size setting, not from stale session cluster state.
cause_summary: The shared timeline-ignoring helpers depended on mutable session cluster state, which could drift from the graph model that hidden dashboard data views were expected to use.
fix_summary: CommonService now rebuilds a derived non-timeline cluster summary from the current visible links and active cluster minimum, `getVisibleNodesIgnoringTimeline()` normalizes node cluster and degree state from that summary, and Aggregate cluster datasets now use the new derived cluster getter.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard filtering and timeline propagation journeys both passed on April 10, 2026.

title: Serialize and replay saved dashboard layouts during session reload
observed_behavior: Saving a multi-pane dashboard session preserved `tabs` metadata but did not serialize or reapply the Golden Layout dashboard state, so re-uploading the `.microbetrace` file could fall back to a generic single-view session and lose the saved multi-pane tab set.
intended_behavior: A saved dashboard session should reopen into the same multi-pane dashboard structure with the saved active tab and interactive panes already restored.
cause_summary: The session save path only wrote lightweight tab metadata, while the reload path never consumed that metadata and had no serialized dashboard layout to replay after the session graph finished loading.
fix_summary: Session saves now serialize `dashboardLayout` for multi-pane dashboards, and the reload path reapplies the saved Golden Layout after the initial render, resyncs homepage tabs, and republishes per-view load hooks so restored panes hydrate immediately.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard round-trip journey passed on April 14, 2026.
